findings.conclusion: HEXROLL is a source-verified B/X/OSE-compatible generation alternative covering documented generation, editing, rerolls and export. It was already mentioned in historical alternatives, so this is validation of a resource rather than a new independent market participant.
findings.effect: Use concrete capabilities and boundaries when discussing unresolved OSE L1 need; do not treat mere creation-practice evidence as willingness to switch.

findings.conclusion: Online sandbox state, HBF rendered archive and SVG map image are three different artifacts. Six actual source read/search paths confirm the offline-viewer architecture with a synthetic database.
findings.effect: A visible saved map is not proof of portable editable generation. Any future interoperability claim needs a concrete edit/reopen roundtrip and compatible data, not simply an export button.

findings.conclusion: Creator campaigns, project documentation, itch listing and Github are correlated one-project sources. Historical OSE case versions/articles remain duplicates; planned Drowned Lands stays planned.
findings.effect: No new activeGM denominator, observed share or adoption count is obtained. No numeric replacement forM,p,T or weight is justified.

findings.conclusion: An editable offline file is a useful comparison axis, but Worldographer documents one already; it is not a proven unique HexCrawl differentiator.
findings.effect: Do not launch new integration, revive deferred underlay027 or duplicate export029 from this evidence alone.
